notes.title: Pinup-Ball 1.06 is live
notes.content:
Pinup-Ball 1.06 is up. The Main update is the inclusion of an Endless Mode (this is the first implementation, so the feature has to be enabled in the options Menu).

This was a feature requested in the forums, and we think it will make competing for leaderboards a lot more interesting. There are still some additional work we wish to do on this feature before considering it "full", so for now remember it must be enabled in the options menu.

Two additional changes are:

- The ball physics in standard mode is a little slower - to make a more noticeable contrast with "Turbo Mode" - which still remains as the more realistic simulation. The game is a little hard for those who just want to relax and enjoy the view, so we're working on getting balance right, but keeping the experience rewarding.

- The tilt function can no longer send the ball downwards, making the feature more responsive and giving the player more control when they are about to lose a ball.

notes.title: Version 1.03 - Physics Preset
notes.content:
We have been reading the feedback we've gotten about the game's Physics and have been working on alterations to the Physics code in order to try to achieve a better feel for the game.

In order to allow people to voice heir opinion, we have added a "Physics Preset" slider which can alter the feeling of the game's Physics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33562900/31dcba65cb7c84568d7a6f9ba0f0cf7d731fcdde.png[/img]

What does this do? In simple words:

- All to the left: Current Physics
- The more to the right: More bounce on the ball / alterations to gravity / etc... (changes to the physics of the game to try to simulate a more realistic Pinball experience).

Hopefully people can try the slider out, and see how they feel about the new Physics. We added this as a slider so that people can gradually change the parameters, in case they feel a "middle ground" is where the game feels best.

Let us know your opinions in the forums, and stay tuned for further updates.
